requests.title: Loyalty points and referral reward cost by month
requests.question: How much is the loyalty/referral programme costing the business each month - points value issued and redeemed, outstanding points liability, and referral rewards paid - and is that cost trending up or down?
requests.grain: one calendar month (platform-wide, all tenants combined)
columns: cumulative points liability outstanding (EUR, running total since 2023-01-01)
requests.details: Time window: 2023-01-01 through 2025-12-31, grouped by calendar month (use calendar_days.month_label or date_trunc on occurred_at). Points value: from loyalty_transactions, convert points to currency using the points' loyalty_programs.points_per_currency and loyalty_programs.currency_code (amount_in_program_currency = points / points_per_currency), split by direction (treat the 'earn' direction as positive issuance and the other direction as redemption). Then convert that program-currency amount to EUR using exchange_rates (base_code='EUR', quote_code=program currency, as_of = the transaction date; EUR_amount = amount_in_currency / rate). Net points liability change = earned value - redeemed value for the month; cumulative liability outstanding = running sum of net change from the start of history through the end of that month. Referral rewards paid: sum of referral_redemptions.reward_amount by redeemed_at month, converted from referral_redemptions.currency_code to EUR the same way. Referral redemptions count: count of referral_redemptions rows per month. New loyalty enrollments: count of loyalty_accounts.enrolled_at per month. Order by month ascending.

requests.title: Loyalty member vs non-member customer behavior
requests.question: Do enrolled loyalty members actually order more often, spend more, stick around longer, and return items less than non-member customers, as of today?
requests.grain: one row per customer segment: 'loyalty member' vs 'non-member'
columns: avg customer tenure days (first order to last order)
refund rate (% of orders with any amount refunded or an associated return)
requests.details: Population: all users (is_staff = false) across all tenants who have placed at least one order (any status) between 2023-01-01 and 2025-12-31. Segment = 'loyalty member' if the user has a row in loyalty_accounts (any program, any tenant), else 'non-member'. Revenue and order value: use orders.grand_total converted to EUR via exchange_rates using orders.currency_code and the rate as_of orders.placed_at (fall back to created_at if placed_at is null). Avg lifetime revenue per customer = total EUR revenue from non-cancelled orders / customer count in segment. Avg order value = total EUR revenue / total order count in segment. Tenure = days between each customer's first and last placed order (0 for single-order customers). Repeat purchase rate = share of customers in the segment with 2 or more orders. Refund rate = (orders with payments.amount_refunded > 0 OR an order_returns row) / total orders in the segment. Order rows with 'loyalty member' first, then 'non-member'.

requests.title: Referred vs non-referred customer early behavior
requests.question: Do customers acquired through a referral behave better in their first 90 days - more orders, more revenue, more likely to return, fewer refunds - than customers acquired another way?
requests.grain: one row per acquisition segment: 'referred' vs 'other'
columns: share with a 2nd order within 90 days (%)
share with a 2nd order within 90-180 days (%)
requests.details: Population: users (is_staff = false) across all tenants whose account created_at is between 2023-01-01 and 2025-10-02 (so a full 90-day and 180-day window is observable before data end 2025-12-31), and who placed at least one order. Segment = 'referred' if the user appears as referred_user_id in referral_redemptions, else 'other'. For each customer, 'day 0' is their first order's placed_at. Orders/revenue in first 90 days = orders placed in [day0, day0+90 days); revenue in orders.grand_total converted to EUR via exchange_rates (rate as_of placed_at, orders.currency_code to EUR). 'Share with a 2nd order within 90 days' = % of customers with a 2nd distinct order placed within 90 days of day 0. 'Share with a 2nd order within 90-180 days' = % of customers (among those without a 2nd order in the first 90 days) whose 2nd order falls between day0+90 and day0+180. Refund rate within first 90 days = share of orders placed in that window that have payments.amount_refunded > 0 or an order_returns row. Order rows with 'referred' first, then 'other'.
